questions.question:
Select the option that represents the letters that when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below will complete

the letter series.

_ P _ J _ P _ P _ _ P _
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: _ P _ J _ P _ P _ _ P _

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

**Option 1) JPPJPJP **→ __**J**__ P __**P**__ / J __**P**__ P / __**J**__ P __**P**__** / **__**J**__ P __**P**__

Here, 'J P P' is the pattern.

Option 2) PPJJJJJ → __P__ P __P__ / J __J__ P / __J__ P __J__ / __J__ P __J__

Option 3) JPJPJPJ → __J__ P __P__ / J __J__ P / __P__ P __J__ / __P__ P __J__

Option 4) JJPPPPJ → __J__ P __J__ / J __P__ P / __P__ P __P__ / __P__ P __J__

Hence, the correct answer is "**JPPJPJP**".

questions.question:
What will come in place of ‘?’ in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘–‘ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

6 ÷ 8 – 91 × 13 + 30 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

After decoding signs:

 
 

 Signs
 Decoded signs
 
 

 +
 -

 ×
 ÷

 ×
 
 

 

Given equation: 6 ÷ 8 – 91 × 13 + 30 = ?

After interchanging the signs then:

⇒ 6 × 8 + __**91 ÷ 13 **__- 30 = ?

⇒ ? = **__6 × 8__** + 7 - 30

⇒ ? = __**48 + 7**__ - 30

⇒ ? = __**55 - 30**__ =** 25**

Hence, the correct answer is "25".

questions.question:
Select the triad in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the given triads.

(54, 65, 76), (48, 59, 70)

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent

digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1

and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (1st number + 3rd number) ÷ 2 = 2nd number.

Now,

For, (54, 65, 76)

⇒ (54 + 76) ÷ 2 = 130 ÷ 2 = 65.

For, (48, 59, 70)

⇒ (48 + 70) ÷ 2 = 118 ÷ 2 = 59.

Similarly, For (38, 49, 60)

**⇒ (38 + 60) ÷ 2 = 98 ÷ 2 = 49.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some circles are rectangles.

Some rectangles are squares.

All squares are triangles.

**Conclusions:**

I. No circle is a triangle.

II. Some rectangles are triangles.

III. All rectangles are triangles.

options.text: Both conclusion I and II follow

questions.solution:
Given Statements:

Some circles are rectangles.

Some rectangles are squares.

All squares are triangles.

The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e07bb8524202d217dada9fdeea7c1e47d047a10a60764cb6c104e07b0f2400ca.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No circle is a triangle. - **False **(because there is no direct relation given between circle and triangle, so it can be possible but not definite)

II. Some rectangles are triangles. - **True **(because Some rectangles are squares and All squares are triangles. So, Some rectangles are triangles it is definite)

III. All rectangles are triangles. - **False **(because Some rectangles are squares and All squares are triangles. So, All rectangles are triangles it is not definite)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion II follows".**
